entries.title: Tiered affixes, resonance gems, Rogue and Bard changes

sections.heading: Wardrobe (new)
items: New Wardrobe page 👑: spend gold on cosmetics that change only how you look — 11 name colours (up to animated Prismatic), 17 titles, 9 portrait frames (up to the animated Void frame) and 9 profile borders. Prices go from 5,000 to 5,000,000 gold.
Some titles are earned through achievements instead of bought (e.g. "Bossbane", "the Legendary").
Hover any cosmetic to try it on. What you wear is shown to other players in chat, rankings, rift rankings, groups, the arena, co-op battles and when they inspect you.

Your hero's name now has your name colour too: in combat, the top bar, the Character and Party pages, rankings, groups, the arena and when others inspect you. Your hero's portrait wears your frame everywhere as well, including on the battlefield (also in co-op, where every player's hero shows their own frame).

Portrait frames are much flashier: metal frames get a shine sweep, Runic and Verdant Vines turning rune circles, Ember a flickering fire aura with rising sparks, Frostfire twinkling ice sparkles, Celestial a breathing halo with orbiting stars, and Void a swirling vortex with motes pulled around it.

New cosmetic: profile borders (9, from 5,000 to 5,000,000 gold) go around your inspect window when other players look at your profile, with their own effects: shining metal trims, marching rune dashes, a fire border with rising sparks, icy corner sparkles, a comet of light racing around the Starlit border, and the churning Abyss.

sections.heading: Items
items: New affix system: items roll prefixes and suffixes (up to 3 of each) from 41 different stats. Uncommon items get 1 affix, Rare 2, Epic 3, Legendary 4 and Mythic now 6.
Every affix has a tier from T7 to T1. Better tiers need a higher item level, are much rarer and give bigger values. Hover an item to see each affix's tier and its possible range.
Item tooltips group affixes under Prefixes (blue) and Suffixes (orange), with how many of the 3 slots each uses.
Strong stats like Damage %, Life Steal, Cooldown Recovery and All Attributes are rare; plain attributes, Health and Defense are common.

New stats include Physical/Magic Damage %, Life Steal, Block, Dodge, Damage Reduction, Health Regeneration, Healing Received, Cooldown Recovery, Damage vs Bosses, Damage vs Wounded, Shield Strength, Thorns and more.
The best prefix and suffix now name the item, e.g. "Brutal Steel Sword of the Fox".
All existing items were converted: they keep their base, level, rarity, sockets, gems and enchantment and got new tiered affixes.
Gear scaled down by ascension is soulbound: it can't be sold on the Auction House until you reforge it back to its original item level.
Loot filter: new conditions for the best affix tier on an item ("has a tier 2 or better affix", "no affix better than tier 5").

Mythic items are much rarer: loot boosts from bosses, rifts and crafting no longer raise the chance for Legendary and Mythic beyond Epic's. A boss drop is now Mythic about 1% of the time instead of 9–18%.

Juggernaut's Bulwark (4 pieces): Shield Wall now triggers from any ability that taunts — e.g. the Sentinel's Shield Slam, Challenging Shout or Guardian's Oath — not just the Warrior's Taunt. It can trigger at most once every 10 seconds (the same as Taunt's cooldown).

Uniques that already dropped now follow changes to their definition: base item, slot, fixed stats and name are updated (their random affixes, level, socket, gem, enchantment and soulbinding stay). If a worn unique moves to another slot or its wearer's class can no longer use it, it is taken off and sent to you by mail.

sections.heading: Ability ranks
items: 18 new rank effects (shown on the ability cards and skill tree):
Warrior — Heroic Strike 3: hits again for 50% below 50% health · Battle Cry 2: +10 Rage per buffed ally · Shield Wall 3: a shield worth 20% of the damage it prevented when it ends.
Mage — Frost Bolt 2: every third bolt on the same enemy freezes it for 1 s · Flame Wave 3: burning ground on every enemy hit · Meteor 3: a kill gives back half the cooldown.
Ranger — Aimed Shot 3: always crits on targets with Hunter's Mark · Multi-Shot 2: 25% chance per enemy to poison it like Serpent Sting · Rapid Fire 3: every hit lowers Kill Shot's cooldown by 1 s.
Warlock — Agony 3: each tick has a 10% chance to add a stack · Blight 2: spreads to another enemy when the target dies · Dark Pact 3: the health cost comes back over 6 s.
Summoner — Bone Golem 3: a bone shield (30% of its health) when it dies · Summon Imps 2: imps explode when they die · Soul Link 3: you heal for 10% of the damage linked allies take.
Chronomancer — Haste 3: the target's next ability has no cooldown · Rewind 2: also removes all debuffs · Time Dilation 3: enemies deal 10% less damage while it lasts.

sections.heading: Gems
items: Gems were reworked into 11 resonance gems. A socketed gem changes the affixes of its own item instead of adding a flat stat.
Ladder, Keystone, Underdog, Harmony, Balance, Purity, Sacrifice and Mirror work all the time; Tide, Last Stand and Momentum change your item in combat.
Every gem comes in 5 qualities (Chipped to Perfect); 3 gems fuse into the next quality at the Jeweler. One gem of each kind per item.
Every item now has at most one socket. Items with more lost the extra sockets; their gems went back into your pouch.
Gems drop from enemies of level 18 and above (bosses and rifts most often, better qualities from higher-level enemies). The Jeweler can also cut a Chipped gem of your choice from Gem Fragments.
Stat shards are gone. Your old gems and shards were turned into Gem Fragments.
Item tooltips show what the gems do: changed tiers, bonuses (◆), sacrificed and mirrored affixes.

sections.heading: Rogue
items: New ability Assassin's Mark (Assassination path, outer ring): mark an enemy for 6 seconds. All damage you deal to it is recorded, and when the mark runs out it explodes for 150% of the recorded damage.
Plaguebringer: poisoning an enemy that is already bleeding now spreads the poison to every enemy.
Poisons hit harder: Poison Blade 18% → 25% Physical Power per stack per second, Plague Strike 35% → 45%, Toxic Cloud 30% → 40%.
Poison Blade has a higher priority, so automatic loadouts now include it.
Ability ranks can now unlock extra effects. First one: Expose Weakness at rank 3 also gives you Opportunist for 10 s — every direct hit on an exposed enemy restores 4 Energy.
Shadow Flurry at rank 2 (Serrated Flurry): every hit against a poisoned enemy also makes it bleed — with Plaguebringer, your next poison then spreads to every enemy.
Backstab at rank 3 (Cold Blood): a critical Backstab refunds 15 Energy.
Poison and Bleed have no stack limit anymore (were 5 and 3). Every application is its own stack with its own timer, so stacks build up while you keep applying them and fall off one by one.

Execute reworked: instead of triple damage below 30% health, it now deals 30% more for every Bleed stack on the target — below 15% health at rank 1, 30% at rank 2 and 45% at rank 3. The Assassin's Merciless Execute raises that threshold by 15%.
Evasion at rank 2 (Slippery): every hit you dodge while Evasion is active restores 5 Energy.

sections.heading: Auction House
items: New affix filter: search for up to 6 stats, each with a minimum value and/or a minimum affix tier, and choose whether an item needs all or any of them.

Also filter by the best affix tier on an item, the number of affixes and its socket (empty, has a gem, or a specific gem). Results show the filtered stats with their tiers, and you can sort by the first filtered stat.

sections.heading: Expeditions
items: Longer expeditions now pay off: per hour they give more materials and XP instead of less. 1 hour +2%, 4 hours +5%, 8 hours +10% per hour compared to a 15-minute trip (before, 8 hours gave about 24% less per hour).

sections.heading: Bard
items: Finale is now passive: once three notes have been played, the Bard plays the Finale automatically (15 s cooldown). It no longer needs a loadout slot, so recruited Bards can use 1 more of their other spells.
While Finale recharges the notes keep rotating but don't count; the next three notes after the cooldown form the next Finale.

sections.heading: Spellblade
items: Arcane Infusion reworked into Spellstrike: for 8 seconds every weapon ability also deals a magic hit, and every spell a physical hit, for 40% of its damage.

sections.heading: Rifts
items: Every rift tier now has a fixed theme and enemy line-up, and the themes are balanced to be equally hard.

sections.heading: Town
items: The Enchanter now has the same layout as reforging.

Salvage Yard: filter items by name or stat search, slot, rarity (also "Rare or lower" and uniques & sets), maximum item level and locked state; sort by rarity, level, slot or most materials; "Select shown" selects every unlocked item that is shown.

sections.heading: Multiplayer
items: The group leader can now choose which offered recruits fight: "✓ Fights" / "Let fight" next to each member's recruit, or "Automatic" to go back to the old choice (missing roles first, then in turn). Still at most one recruit per player. The choice resets when someone joins or leaves or the leader changes.

sections.heading: Interface
items: The inventory moved onto the Character page, next to the equipment. Hovering an item compares it with what the selected character wears in that slot; items the character can't use are dimmed, marked ✖ and say why. Drag items onto an equipment slot to equip them (swapping with what's there), and drag equipped gear back to the inventory to unequip it. The loot filter and the filtered-loot log open in a window from the inventory's header.
Builds: every character has 3 build slots on the Skill Tree and Abilities pages. A build saves the skill tree, the ability loadout and the ability rules, and switching between saved builds is free.

Planned builds: on the Skill Tree page, "Plan nodes" lets you click out a whole build in advance (e.g. up to level 60). Free and future skill points are spent on the planned nodes automatically, in the order you set. Builds save the plan too.
Threat display in fights: every party member shows its threat (share of the highest threat on an enemy; red with 🎯 when enemies attack it), and every enemy shows who it is attacking.

New ability conditions: "An enemy is attacking me" (use NOT for "I don't have aggro"), "Number of enemies attacking me", "An enemy is attacking someone else (not me)" (great for taunts), "Number of enemies attacking someone else", and the target conditions "Target is attacking me" / "Target is attacking someone else".
New targets for ally abilities: Party member 1–4 (by their place in the party; the rule editor shows who that is). If that member is down, the ability waits.
Patch notes: the 📜 button next to announcements shows what changed. A dot appears when there is something new.
Abilities page: every learned ability shows what it does right now — with its rank, skill-tree changes and rank effects applied, and the real numbers from your character's stats.
Fixed: an ending fight no longer refreshes the page while you have a dropdown open; the page updates once you've made your choice.
Fixed: the combat page no longer jumps up and down when minions are summoned or die — party members and enemies stay in place.
Pop-up messages now appear centered at the bottom of the screen instead of the bottom right.

Inventory highlight: type a name or stat (e.g. "crit fire") or add stat rows with a minimum value and affix tier, and every matching item lights up. Optionally show only the matches. Your highlight is remembered in this browser.
Fixed dead enemies staying on the battlefield after a new wave started.

Minion stats: summon abilities in the skill tree and on the Abilities page now show what the minion would have if summoned right now (health, damage per hit, attack speed, defense, crit, duration and how many you can have), including your gear, skill tree bonuses and the ability's rank. Rank nodes show the change to the next rank, and minion nodes like Thick Bones show each of your minions before and after.

New 💡 button next to the announcements: send the admins a suggestion (feature idea, balance, bug report, interface or other). You see your own suggestions with their status (Sent, Read, Planned, Done, Declined) and any reply from the admins.

Tooltips always stay fully inside the window: they flip to the other side of the cursor when there's no room and are pushed back from the edges, also on small screens and for very tall item comparisons.

Pages no longer reset when a fight ends or your gold changes: instead of redrawing everything, only the parts that changed are updated. Scroll positions (e.g. in the inventory), text you're typing, open dropdowns, hovered tooltips and animations all stay as they are.

entries.title: Arena, six new classes and the Wiki

sections.heading: Arena
items: New: the Arena (from hero level 12). Choose one of your party setups as your arena team and attack other players' teams to earn arena rating and gold.
Both teams are synced to the average level of the two heroes. Damage, healing and stuns are reduced in the arena.

sections.heading: Classes
items: Six new classes: Sentinel, Druid, Chronomancer, Alchemist, Bard and Spellblade (13 in total).
New class: Warlock, with stacking curses and damage over time. Drain Life is its starting spell.
Cleric and Druid are now different healers: the Cleric heals in bursts (new: Holy Nova), the Druid heals over time (new: Regrowth, Nature's Cure).
Summoner (Lich): Grave Detonation now makes Corpse Explosion detonate every minion at once.
Ability ranks now also make summoned minions stronger (+20% health and power per rank).
New AI target condition: my debuff stacks on the target. Reap now only needs one of your DoTs on the target.

sections.heading: Co-op
items: At most 4 characters per co-op fight, and every player brings only one recruit.
Recruits fill missing roles first (healer, then tank). Enemies get stronger with every character beyond two.
Fixed: the co-op fight view sometimes got stuck.

sections.heading: Interface
items: New in-game Wiki with classes, abilities, skill trees, statuses, items, the town and zones.
Shields are now shown on health bars.
Hero creation: classes are grouped by role.
Tutorial: the first fights can't be lost, and only the highlighted buttons can be clicked.
Character sheet: equipped items no longer overflow their card.
